_how_to_edit: Newest first. 'date' is YYYY-MM. 'tag' is one of Paper, Award, Funding, Event, Press (new tags appear automatically). 'text' may contain simple HTML links. Optional 'images': [{src, alt}].

news.title: Best Poster Award for Omid
news.text: Congratulations to Omid for receiving the Best Poster Award at the AI-Augmented Chemistry Symposium organized by Syngenta.

news.title: SIMORGH accepted at the SimBioChem workshop (NeurIPS 2026)
news.text: We are excited to announce that our latest ensemble-aware model, SIMORGH is accepted in SIMBIOCHEM2 workshop at NeurIPS 2026. SIMORGH predicts protein-ligand binding sites in realistic apo states with reliable performance for cryptic sites as well. Congratulations to Omid for this great development.

news.title: BindCORE is now on bioRxiv
news.text: We are excited to announce that our latest work, BindCORE is now available on bioRxiv. BindCORE takes advantage of IDR's biophysical properties to predict binding regions including MoRFs and LIPs. Congratulations to Nicolas and Luiz for putting together this great work.

news.title: Three posters at ICML 2026
news.text: A very busy conference for our PhD candidate - Luiz presented three posters at ICML 2026, related to three different accepted papers. Well done!

news.title: The 4th Nancy Computational Structural Biology conference (NCSB)
news.text: The 4th edition of Nancy Computational Structural Biology Conference is over. It was a great event with many interesting talks and discussions. We would like to thank all the participants and speakers for their valuable contributions.

news.title: Dataset paper accepted at the ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
news.text: We are happy to announce that our Dataset proposal is accepted at the AI for Science Workshop at ICML 2026. We hope it fills the current gap and pushes forward for NA and protein-NA sampling, site prediction, and design approaches. See the article here.

news.title: Delta officially joins Inria
news.text: We are happy to announce that Delta is officially passed all evaluations and joined Inria. Please read about our work in a feature article published by the Centre Inria at Université de Lorraine. See the article here.

news.title: Allosteric site prediction and benchmark bias, now on bioRxiv
news.text: Congratulations to Yasaman and Victor for their great work on allosteric site prediction and discovering the existing benchmark bias that is available now on bioRxiv.

news.title: InterMap published in JCTC
news.text: We are happy to announce that our latest work, InterMap is now published in JCTC. InterMap provides accelerated detection of interaction fingerprints on large-scale molecular ensembles. Congratulations to Yasaman and Roy and all co-authors for putting together this great work.

news.title: PROTEUS is now on bioRxiv
news.text: We are happy to announce that our latest work, PROTEUS is now available on bioRxiv. PROTEUS provides sequence-based rapid predictions of protein conformational plasticity. Congratulations to Luiz for putting together this great work.

news.title: Collaboration with Goethe University Frankfurt published in Science Advances
news.text: We are happy to announce that the results of our nice collaboration with Christoph Welsch (Goethe University Frankfurt) is now published in Science Advances. Congratulations to all authors for this amazing story.

news.title: ppIRIS published in Advanced Science
news.text: Our recent work ppIRIS is now published in Advanced Science. Congrats to Luiz for his amazing work.

news.title: Binder design for the human surfaceome published in PNAS
news.text: Our large-scale collaboration with EPFL and Novo Nordisk on de novo protein binder design for the entire human surfaceome is now published in PNAS.

news.title: NCSB 2026 announced
news.text: We are happy to announce that the 4th NCSB will be held on June 9th at Nancy, with the support of the Centre Inria de l’Universite de Lorraine, LORIA, and ANR under the France 2030 grant operated by the Inria Quadrant Program. We have the pleasure of hosting internationally distinguished experts in computational and structural biology. Here is the program. To register please visit here.

news.title: DynamicGT published in Cell Systems
news.text: Our recent work DynamicGT is now published in Cell Systems. Congrats to Omid for his second PhD paper.

news.title: DynaRepo highlighted by GENCI in the Jean Zay 4 Grand Challenges
news.text: DynaRepo has been selected as one of ten flagship scientific projects highlighted by GENCI for the Jean Zay 4 Grand Challenges (2024–2025). 3.8 million H100 GPU hours across different disciplines! See the article here

news.title: Feature article on antibody engineering
news.text: Our recent works in antibody engineering were highlighted in a feature article published by the Centre Inria at Université de Lorraine. See the article here.

news.title: ANR-PIQ grant (DynaNova)
news.text: Yasaman has been awarded the ANR-PIQ grant for the DynaNova project to advance research on protein allosteric signaling. (Link)

news.title: ANR-JCJC grant (IDPFold)
news.text: Hamed has been awarded the ANR-JCJC grant for the IDPFold project, focused on investigating folding-upon-binding mechanisms in intrinsically disordered proteins. (Link)

news.title: ANR-PRC grant (VITAL)
news.text: Hamed and collaborators have been awarded the ANR-PRC VITAL grant to support their collaborative research initiatives. (Link)

news.title: ANR-PRC grant (GlycoLink)
news.text: Hamed and collaborators have been awarded the ANR-PRC GlycoLink grant to advance research in glycoscience. (Link)
